execution_rules.parameter_basis: User confirmed EUR 750 per initial asset purchase and temporary 0-1 funds while waiting for BUY gates, 2026-11-04.
execution_rules.buy_gate_basis: User removed purchase signal restrictions at both stages, including scenario-conditional purchase opportunity. Purchases are selected by the optimisation objective; all budget, liquidity, history, lot-size, initial EUR750 and sale gates remain.
execution_rules.sale_permission_basis: User explicitly removed technical SELL-vote and negative-forecast requirements for Sale variants at all decision stages, 2026-11-11. No-sale variants still prohibit sales. Other execution and portfolio constraints remain.

summary.algorithm: Block coordinate integer neighbourhood heuristic, eight dynamically ranked eligible candidates per node; exact FSD/SSD/TSD scoring; two CPU/CUDA sweeps; every final scenario independently rescored on CPU

common.definition: Minimum gross purchase units across every positive-probability node in the stated stage, including nodes with zero purchases. Future-total minimum is the minimum sum along each complete path, not the sum of stage minima.
